state_budget.one_step_floor: F_rho=max(F,R-rho*(R-F)); the max only clamps tinynegative headroom admitted by the declared1e-12 historical event equality convention.
state_budget.rho: Normative fraction of currently remaining drawdown headroom allowed next year, not an event probability/preference estimate.
state_budget.support: All own-training current-calendar joint asset/inflation realgross rows. Positive linear inequalities also protect the convex hull plus nonnegative assetwise shifts. No true future support containment assumption is validated.
state_budget.guarantee: One-step annual endpoint only if declared support condition holds; no recursive feasibility, intrayear drawdown or future probability certificate.

actions.initial: Mandatory exact full original Q1 target if support-feasible, otherwise preinvestmentReview for every same-fit C scenario; no actual future or ID selection.
actions.proposals: a*w+(1-a)*e_bill, a=1/.75/.5/.25, temporary period proposals; original base target persists.
actions.partial: For each full-target endpoint y* with exact fee C*, use post-dollar segment y(q)=x+q*(y*-x), fee(q)=q*C*. All joint inequalities give a closed feasible interval. Compare lo/mid/hi plus hold, at most13 actions; no continuous global optimum claim.
actions.growth_score: Uniform Elog(W_action/W_hold), or minimum of this paired expectedlog advantage over five descriptive forecasts; hold score0.
actions.forecasts: Current-calendar growth rows; uniform + 50%Gaussian previous-state/50%uniform shrinkage + three sorted-ID equal-size block means. Train-only scales; blocks are sensitivity forecasts, not independent samples or confidence intervals. Inception onlyuniform.
actions.growth_trade: If hold support-feasible, only strictly positive selected pairedscore>1e-12 may trade. Already-net advantage includes the fee once. One-step grosslog advantage plus log(1-C/V) equals netlog advantage.
actions.protective_trade: If hold violates the chosen budget, a feasible action restores its supported worst shortfall after fees. Disclose fee, purchasing-power shortfall improvement and any expected growth sacrifice; risk constraint is normative, not an inferred psychological utility.
actions.ties: One global scoremax band1e-12; hold first, then lower actual nominalfee, lower proposalorder, lower candidateindex.
actions.no_feasible: Only the declared proposal family is infeasible. Once funded refer and hold absorbingly, retaining actual exposures/CPI/peak/MDD/H to horizon. No hypothetical human liquidation/returns. Initial Review has no financial account.
actions.breach: Strict original actual MDD-L>1e-12 causes absorbing pending; budget/referral never resets previous losses.

selection.data: All four inner OOF complete policies, pooled once by originalID; no outer outcomes or refit outcomes select a candidate.
selection.eligibility: Nonzero initial financial coverage; events<=floor(.1*n_fin+1e-12), meanMDD and CVaR90MDD no worse than own-target annual/pending B on identical funded IDs. These empirical norms are not statistical superiority or population bounds.
selection.objective: Maximize initial invested count; minimize funded support-infeasibility referrals; maximize complete-H net mean log growth; lower fees and declared order resolve global numeric ties.
selection.refit: Apply exactly inner-selected candidate to the corresponding full training Q1 target/support. If initial infeasible, Review; do not rescue by selecting another candidate.
selection.no_same_B_count_gate: Previous separate no-worse B event-count guard is not transferred. Retain .1 absolute reference and add explicit loss-severity constraints. This is a declared structural redesign motivated by earlier evidence, not retrospective prespecification.
